1. Why Is the World Obsessed with Korean Seaweed?! Korea’s Massive Production Meeting Explosive Demand

Seaweed is called the ocean’s superfood, and it has become a beloved food not only in Korea but around the world.
Carefully washed and dried in Korea, it is roasted and flavored at the O’Food plant in Vietnam, where it has now become a popular food as well.
With both sustainability and nutrition in every sheet, King Process reveals the remarkable story of its large-scale production.
